items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: Phil Harris is coming in on a Friday night and fooling with the forks.

ctx.x: So when did you come back to Chicago? And what were the circumstances? What had been happening in Chicago from what we'd been talking about earlier?
Okay, now we go back to 1949. Pee Wee and Art have opened up Pee Wee and Art's Back Room. Phil Harris is coming in on a Friday night and fooling with the forks. He's a drummer.
